snippet.title: This will not go well
snippet.description:
The trailer for the game "This will not go well" made by ECS (Eternal CODE Studio).

You can get the game in:
- Steam (Windows and Linux): https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275260/This_will_not_go_well/
- Google Play Store (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ECS.ThisWillNotGoWell
